issuer_or_brand: Visa (U.S. Visa Infinite benefit; your issuing bank's Guide to Benefits governs)
coverage_summary: Any brand paid for with a U.S. Visa Infinite card: one extra year on a manufacturer's warranty of 3 years or less
watch_phrases: Extended Warranty Protection will extend the term of your eligible manufacturer's U.S. warranty by 1 additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less
mandatory_conditions: The item was bought with a covered Visa Infinite card
The item has an eligible manufacturer's U.S. warranty of 3 years or less
The claim follows the terms and reporting deadline in your issuer's Guide to Benefits
exclusions_and_caveats: Visa's page says certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; the exact terms are in the Guide to Benefits from your card issuer
Claim limits, reporting deadlines and required documents are not stated on Visa's page and vary by issuer
Not every Visa card carries this benefit; check that your specific card is a covered Visa Infinite card
